title: Pakistan, Türkiye Edge Closer to Joining Saudi War Against Houthis
detail: Al Jazeera reported on Sep 25 that Pakistan and Türkiye are edging closer to a military role in Saudi Arabia's confrontation with the Houthis, after weeks of purely diplomatic responses. Pakistan had said on Sep 10 it was not considering an immediate military response under the pact.
